name: Apprenticeship at Randstad Digital
description: Three-year apprenticeship in Bavaria, where I learned to build backends with Java and frontends with Angular.

name: Customer project: Automotive
description:
A large automotive project that ran for more than three years, mostly on the backend. I was part of the move from on-premise to AWS and helped run the system in the cloud afterwards. The application calculates CO2 and emission values for vehicles and generates standard-compliant documents.

• Built features in the Java backend
• Designed and connected OpenAPI interfaces
• Modelled data in Oracle
• Also took on Angular frontend tasks
• Supported the migration to AWS
• Deployed and ran features on AWS
• Built monitoring dashboards with CloudWatch
• Tracked down and fixed bugs

name: AWS Certified: Cloud Practitioner
description: With the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, I proved my foundational knowledge of AWS services.

name: Personal website
description: My portfolio, built with Angular and Tailwind CSS and published to GitHub Pages automatically with GitHub Actions. It's where I show my projects and try out new frontend ideas.

name: Customer project: Finance
description:
A full-stack project in finance. We're bringing existing business applications together into one web platform.

• Building the frontend with Angular
• Building the backend with Java and Spring
• Lots of agentic coding with GitHub Copilot day to day
